title: Silver Zoom Card: Fuel Purchase Reporting and Analytics
summary: This document explains how the Silver Zoom Card’s fuel analytics work, including a 10.0% reduction applied to eligible fuel transactions and 3.0% category earnings on qualifying transportation/logistics expenses. It lists the key fields (discount/category rates, merchant/station identifiers) and procedures to filter, export, reconcile, and perform variance and receipt-audit checks.
faqs: Where can I find the fuel summary showing total fuel spend and the 10.0% reductions applied?
Which report shows category earnings and that rewards are accrued at a 3.0% rate?
What fields should I review to confirm the 10.0% discount and the 3.0% category rate were applied correctly?
How do I filter transactions to isolate in-network fueling where the 10.0% reduction applied?
How can I reconcile reported reductions and rewards against my route plans and accounting system?
What variance and receipt-audit steps can I use to detect out-of-network fueling where the expected discount didn’t apply?
